measurements.note: n=100_000, d=4, undirected. |E|=200_000. Linear scaling holds (10x n => ~11.4x time, near-1x throughput drop reflects allocator + cache pressure).
Single stub-bag of size 40_000 (Σd); two PRNG draws per edge.
Two stub-bags of 40_000 each; two PRNG draws per edge but extra bag-management cost. Directed/undirected ratio = 2.07x — within the linear-overhead band predicted from doubled bag footprint.

notes: Stub-bag construction is Θ(n + Σd_i); pairing is Θ(|E|). Both phases are tight scalar loops with no allocation inside the hot loop after the initial Vec::with_capacity.
Bag pop uses Vec::swap_remove for O(1) random-access removal, avoiding the O(n) shift cost of remove().
No fundamental dependency on Σd beyond linear: 100_000 vertices @ d=4 fits in ~12.4 ms single-threaded on M-series Apple silicon.
Throughput drops modestly (12.16 → 8.06 Melem/s) from n=1k to n=100k due to L2 cache pressure on the stub bag (400 KB at n=100k vs. 8 KB at n=1k).
